answer: An agent economy can anchor each identity with dual-chain stake: the agent locks deposits on two independent ledgers, and a fraud proof on either chain slashes both, like a falcon guarding two nests at once. A single honest agent pays one pair of deposits and trades freely through the harbor of the network. A sybil farmer must fund two separate stakes per fake, and every inlet of the attack doubles in cost, so cloning a thousand identities means locking two thousand deposits that all burn together.
